IS-4_1.title: Context of the Organization
IS-4_1.description: Determine external and internal issues relevant to the ISMS purpose and that affect your ability to achieve intended outcomes.

IS-4_2.title: Needs of Interested Parties
IS-4_2.description: Identify interested parties (customers, regulators, staff, suppliers) and their requirements relevant to information security.

IS-4_3.title: ISMS Scope
IS-4_3.description: Define and document the boundaries of the ISMS: which systems, locations, and activities are included and excluded, and why.

IS-4_4.title: Information Security Management System
IS-4_4.description: Establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve an ISMS in accordance with ISO 27001 requirements.

IS-5_1.title: Leadership and Commitment
IS-5_1.description: Top management must demonstrate commitment: approve the IS policy, ensure ISMS resources, and integrate security into business processes.

IS-5_2.title: Information Security Policy
IS-5_2.description: Establish, document, and communicate an IS policy signed by top management, including objectives and commitment to continual improvement.

IS-5_3.title: Roles, Responsibilities and Authorities
IS-5_3.description: Assign and communicate responsibilities for information security roles including CISO/ISMS owner, asset owners, and process owners.

IS-6_1.title: Risk Assessment Process
IS-6_1.description: Define and apply a documented risk assessment methodology including risk identification, analysis, evaluation, and acceptance criteria.

IS-6_2.title: Information Security Objectives
IS-6_2.description: Establish measurable IS objectives aligned to the IS policy, document plans to achieve them, and track progress.

IS-6_3.title: Planning of Changes
IS-6_3.description: When changes to the ISMS are needed, plan them in a controlled manner: assess purpose, consequences, integrity, resources, and accountability.

IS-7_1.title: Resources
IS-7_1.description: Determine and provide the resources needed to establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve the ISMS.

IS-7_2.title: Competence
IS-7_2.description: Determine competence requirements for ISMS-relevant roles, provide training, and retain evidence of competence (training records, certificates).

IS-7_3.title: Awareness
IS-7_3.description: Ensure persons doing work under the organization's control are aware of the IS policy, their contribution to ISMS effectiveness, and the implications of non-conformity.

IS-7_4.title: Communication
IS-7_4.description: Determine the internal and external communications relevant to the ISMS: what, when, with whom, how, and by whom.

IS-7_5.title: Documented Information
IS-7_5.description: Create and maintain documented information required by ISO 27001, and control its creation, update, distribution, and retention.

IS-8_1.title: Operational Planning and Control
IS-8_1.description: Plan, implement, and control the processes needed to meet IS requirements and implement the actions determined in Clause 6.

IS-8_2.title: Information Security Risk Assessment
IS-8_2.description: Perform risk assessments at planned intervals or when significant changes occur; document results in a risk register.

IS-8_3.title: Information Security Risk Treatment
IS-8_3.description: Select and implement risk treatment options; produce a risk treatment plan and Statement of Applicability (SoA).

IS-9_1.title: Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation
IS-9_1.description: Define what to monitor and measure, how, when, and by whom; analyse and evaluate results against IS objectives.

IS-9_2.title: Internal Audit
IS-9_2.description: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals to assess whether the ISMS conforms to requirements and is effectively implemented.

IS-9_3.title: Management Review
IS-9_3.description: Top management reviews the ISMS at planned intervals covering audit results, KPIs, incidents, changes, and improvement opportunities.

IS-10_1.title: Continual Improvement
IS-10_1.description: Continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the ISMS.

IS-10_2.title: Nonconformity and Corrective Action
IS-10_2.description: When nonconformity occurs: react, investigate root cause, implement corrective action, and verify its effectiveness.
